annotations.title: Cross-checks of published figures against independent sources

description: How ASPERN’s published figures hold against independent readings of the SAME metric, from the last cross-check run (every six hours). Per check: the subject, the metric and its definition, our value with its time, block and lineage, the outside value with its source, read time and block where there is one, units, absolute and relative difference, the tolerance rule and why, how the two times align (same_block, same_window, near, unaligned) and a verdict: agree (tight band at the same block or window), within_tolerance (the stated band, or equal at two moments), disagree, not_comparable (different definitions or times that cannot be aligned: never agreement) or source_unavailable. Families: vault (totalAssets at our block, the Morpho API, DefiLlama yields, asset price, share price, APY), stock (supply and issuer wallets at our block, price against Finnhub or DefiLlama), stablecoin (CoinGecko, Kraken, DefiLlama live, the Ethereum supply bound), agent (ERC-8004 at our block and 8004scan, x402 windows and ACP v3 recounted from logs) and flow (deposits and withdrawals re-read from receipts). independence: independent, chain_reread (the chain at our block) or same_upstream (our own source: tests staleness and units only). A sample per run, not every figure. Disagreements come first; each key-metric disagreement carries an open explanation or alerted the operators. FREE.

family.description: Only checks of this family: vault, stock, stablecoin, agent or flow.

metric.description: One metric key, e.g. total_assets_units, tvl_usd, price, erc8004_registrations, flow_amount_usd.

subject.description: One subject: a vault slug, chain:address for a stock token, stablecoin:usdc, erc8004:base, or a contract address.

verdict.description: Only checks with this verdict; disagree lists what to look at first.

name: cross_checks

asOf.description: When the run finished; null before the first run.

byFamily.description: Per family: checks, subjects, compared, byVerdict.

byVerdict.description: Counts per verdict over the whole run.

items.description: The checks: subject, metric, published, ours, theirs (with independence), units, diff, tolerance, alignment, verdict, reason, sampled, checkedAt, explanation.

limits.description: What the run does not establish.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

notRun.description: Parts of the run that did not run, with why.

recurring.description: Disagreements also seen in one of the two runs before.

run.description: runId, startedAt, finishedAt, config (topN, randomN, flowSample), checks.

total.description: Checks matching the filters, before the limit.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
